source: JoSAA 2026 official website, JoSAA Business Rules updated 20-06-2026, CSAB 2026 official website and information brochure references

what_is_josaa.establishedBy: Ministry of Education, Government of India
what_is_josaa.purpose: Centralized seat allocation for admissions to IITs, NITs, IIITs and GFTIs through a single platform

which_exam_for_which.note: Both JEE Main and Advanced qualifiers can apply to NITs/IIITs/GFTIs. Only JEE Advanced qualifiers can apply to IITs.

CSAB.rounds: CSAB-Special 2026 was conducted with three seat-allocation rounds under the DASA + CSAB-Special umbrella. Older years commonly had two special rounds.
CSAB.when: After JoSAA final round, usually August
CSAB.eligibility: Eligibility and fee rules differ by candidate status after JoSAA. Always check the current CSAB information brochure before advising a student to surrender or retain a seat.
CSAB.important: CSAB is a fresh counselling process for vacant NIT+ system seats after JoSAA. IIT seats are not filled through CSAB.

step_by_step_process.name: Registration
step_by_step_process.details: Visit josaa.nic.in. Login using JEE Main application number and password (or JEE Advanced credentials for IIT applicants). Verify personal and academic details fetched from JEE database. No separate registration fee charged by JoSAA.
step_by_step_process.timeline: Opens after JEE Advanced results, typically mid-June

step_by_step_process.name: Choice Filling
step_by_step_process.details: Fill preferences for institutes and programs in order of priority. Can add as many choices as desired (no limit). Order matters - higher preference = higher position in list. Verify OTP before locking choices. CRITICAL: Once the choice filling deadline passes, you CANNOT modify, add, or reorder choices.
tips: Add all possible choices including backup options
Do not keep your first choice as your only choice
Research previous year cutoffs before filling
Include both safe and ambitious choices

step_by_step_process.name: Mock Seat Allotment
step_by_step_process.details: JoSAA releases 1-2 mock allotments before Round 1. Based on your current choices and current registrations. Not binding - just to help students revise their choice list if needed.

step_by_step_process.name: Seat Allotment - Round 1 to Round 6
step_by_step_process.details: Seats allocated based on: JEE rank, category, choices filled, seat availability. Results published on JoSAA portal. After each round, candidates must: (a) Accept/respond to allotted seat, (b) Upload documents, (c) Pay Seat Acceptance Fee.

step_by_step_process.name: Freeze / Float / Slide Decision
step_by_step_process.details: After each round allotment, you must choose one of three options:

FREEZE.meaning: Accept current seat permanently. Exit counselling process. No upgrades considered.
FREEZE.when_to_use: When you are happy with allotted institute and program

FLOAT.meaning: Accept current seat tentatively. Remain open for upgrade to any higher preferred institute/program in subsequent rounds.
FLOAT.when_to_use: When allotted seat is okay but you want to try for better options
FLOAT.note: If no upgrade found in later rounds, you keep current seat

SLIDE.meaning: Accept current institute but want a better branch within the SAME institute in subsequent rounds.
SLIDE.when_to_use: When you are happy with the institute but want a better branch there
SLIDE.note: Upgrades considered only within same institute

important_rules: Float and Slide are NOT available in the last round
If you got your first choice, only Freeze is available
You can change from Float to Slide/Freeze, or Slide to Freeze at any point
Once you Freeze, you CANNOT change to Float/Slide
Failure to respond by deadline = seat cancellation, barred from future rounds

step_by_step_process.name: Document Upload
step_by_step_process.details: Upload scanned copies of all required documents on JoSAA portal. Documents must be clear, legible. File size limits apply (usually under 1MB per document). JoSAA may raise queries if documents are unclear.

step_by_step_process.name: Seat Acceptance Fee Payment
step_by_step_process.details: Pay Seat Acceptance Fee (SAF) online within deadline.

fees.note: Paid only ONCE. Not paid again for subsequent rounds if you Float/Slide. Amount adjusted against institute fee at reporting.

step_by_step_process.refund_policy: If you withdraw seat before final round: Rs 35,000 refunded minus Rs 5,000 processing fee. No refund if you simply do not report to institute.

step_by_step_process.name: Document Verification
step_by_step_process.details: JoSAA verifies uploaded documents online. May raise queries for incorrect/unclear documents. Must respond to queries within deadline. Only after verification clearance can you proceed to final reporting.

step_by_step_process.name: Physical Reporting at Institute
step_by_step_process.details: After final round, report to allotted institute with original documents. Pay remaining admission fee. Complete institute-specific admission formalities. Attend orientation as per institute schedule.
step_by_step_process.note: Some institutes have online reporting followed by physical reporting later. Check institute-specific schedule.

rounds_timeline_2026.note: The app should not rely on hard-coded old schedules. Always check the official JoSAA schedule page for the current admission year.

rounds_timeline_2026.status: Use official JoSAA 2026 schedule documents only
rounds_timeline_2026.note: JoSAA published an updated 2026 schedule on 20-06-2026 and later revised schedule documents. The website should point students to the official schedule rather than giving stale dates.

csab_special_2026.rounds: DASA & CSAB-Special 2026 had three rounds of seat allocation.
csab_special_2026.applies_to: NIT+ system vacant seats after JoSAA; not IITs.
csab_special_2026.advice: Use CSAB as a separate post-JoSAA strategy. Do not tell a student to risk a decent JoSAA seat unless the current CSAB brochure confirms the exact surrender, fee, eligibility and refund consequences for their case.

HS.name: Home State
HS.percentage: 50% of seats in each NIT reserved for students from the state where that NIT is located
HS.how_determined: Based on state you selected at JEE Main registration (not necessarily your birth state or current residence)

OS.name: Other State
OS.percentage: 50% of seats open for students from all states except home state
OS.note: Students from states with no NIT compete in OS quota of nearby NITs

AI.name: All India
AI.note: No home state/other state division for IITs. All seats are All India quota.

quotas_explained.home_state_strategy: If your state has an NIT, you get HS quota advantage there. If you are from a state without an NIT (like Delhi, Bihar in some cases), you compete in OS quota everywhere.
quotas_explained.state_mapping_note: Home state for JoSAA purposes = State you marked in JEE Main application form. This cannot be changed later even if you live elsewhere.

seat_types.OPEN: General category, no income restriction for seat itself (though fee waivers may apply based on income)
seat_types.OBC_NCL: Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer. Must be in central OBC list.
seat_types.EWS: Economically Weaker Section. General category families with income below Rs 8 lakh/year
seat_types.OPEN_PwD: General category persons with benchmark disability
seat_types.Female_only: Seats exclusively for female candidates. If unfilled in early rounds, may be converted to Gender-Neutral.

supernumerary_seats.Female_Supernumerary: Additional seats created at IITs specifically for female candidates to increase female ratio. These are over and above regular seats.

DS.name: Defence Service
DS.eligibility: Children of armed forces personnel killed/disabled in action, or with service disability. Also serving armed forces personnel.

supernumerary_seats.Kashmiri_Migrant: 2 supernumerary seats per institute for Kashmiri migrants who moved out due to terrorism
supernumerary_seats.Foreign_National: Up to 10% supernumerary seats for foreign nationals at IITs

preparatory_course.for: SC/ST/PwD candidates who narrowly missed cutoff for regular B.Tech programs
preparatory_course.after_completion: If they pass preparatory course, they are eligible for regular B.Tech admission next year
preparatory_course.ranks_marked_P: If a rank in JoSAA data has suffix 'P', it is from the Preparatory rank list, not regular rank list

dual_reporting.concept: If you are upgraded to a better institute after Round 1, you need to withdraw from first institute and report fresh to new institute
dual_reporting.note: JoSAA handles this automatically in online process. Seat acceptance fee paid once is transferred.

withdrawal.before_final_round: Can withdraw seat. Refund of SAF minus Rs 5000 processing fee.
withdrawal.after_final_round: No refund of SAF. You lose the seat.
withdrawal.to_join_CSAB: Must withdraw from JoSAA allotted seat before CSAB deadline

common_mistakes.mistake: Using state OBC list instead of Central OBC list
common_mistakes.consequence: Category certificate rejected. Treated as General category. May lose seat.
common_mistakes.fix: Ensure certificate says 'recognized as backward class by Government of India' with central government OM number

common_mistakes.mistake: EWS certificate expired or wrong financial year
common_mistakes.fix: EWS and OBC-NCL certificates must usually be issued on or after April 1 of the admission year; verify the current official format and date rule.

common_mistakes.mistake: Not freezing seat and missing deadline
common_mistakes.consequence: Seat cancelled, barred from all subsequent rounds
common_mistakes.fix: Always submit willingness (Freeze/Float/Slide) before deadline even if you plan to float

common_mistakes.mistake: Name mismatch between JEE form and category certificate
common_mistakes.fix: Ensure name spelling is exactly same across all documents

common_mistakes.consequence: Cannot claim female-only seats even if eligible
common_mistakes.fix: Female candidates should choose 'Female' gender in JEE application

common_mistakes.mistake: Forgetting that Home State = JEE Main registration state, not actual residence
common_mistakes.fix: Check what state you marked in JEE Main form

common_mistakes.mistake: Maharashtra SC/ST/OBC candidates not getting caste validity certificate
common_mistakes.fix: Maharashtra candidates need additional Caste Validity Certificate from Social/Tribal Welfare department

common_mistakes.mistake: Tamil Nadu ST candidates with wrong issuing authority
common_mistakes.fix: TN ST certificates must be from Revenue Divisional Officer specifically

common_mistakes.mistake: Not responding to document verification queries on time
common_mistakes.fix: Check JoSAA portal daily after document upload

common_mistakes.mistake: Thinking you can add new choices after Round 1 results
common_mistakes.consequence: No new choices possible once initial choice filling deadline passes
common_mistakes.fix: Add all possible choices in the initial choice filling itself
